pool.text: Han Chinese colonists began to settle inside the Taipei Basin area.
The historic Bangka Lungshan Temple was built in Wanhua District.
Qingshui Temple was built as a prominent landmark in Wanhua District.
The Taipei Confucius Temple traces its history back to the Qing dynasty.
Taipei became the seat of Taiwan Province by the Qing dynasty.
China ceded Taiwan to the Empire of Japan under the Treaty of Shimonoseki.
The Shandao Temple was built in Zhongzheng District as a large Buddhist temple.
The largest Allied air raid, the Taihoku Air Raid, took place.
The ruling Kuomintang relocated the ROC government and declared Taipei the provisional capital.
Taipei officially became the nation's first special municipality, upgrading from provincial city status.
The Taipei Fine Arts Museum was established as the first modern art museum.
Taipei provided the backdrop for the Wild Lily student rallies.
The National Taiwan Museum has worn its present name since this year.
A new museum opened as the Museum of Contemporary Art Taipei.
Taipei 101 opened and claimed the title of world's tallest building.
The Taipei Arena opened on the site of the former stadium.
The Taiwan High Speed Rail system officially opened for public transportation.
International visitors totaled almost 3 million as a tourism component.
The architectural design for the Taipei Performing Arts Center was determined.
Writer Tao Lin published a novel titled Taipei taking place in New York and Taipei.
